messages:
Jonas Park: Aurelia Health emailed: they need a completed SIG + CAIQ mapping and evidence for privacy controls before their vendor board on Mon. Can we assemble question-by-question and attachments by Fri?
Priya Kapoor: I'm on it. I'll coordinate with security and engineering. Who will own the Qs about data residency and encryption?
Theo Ramirez: I'll take privacy and encryption. Need the KMS integration doc, sample policy, and note on key custody for Private deployment.
Anika Bose: I can handle network & infra Qs (VPC, peering, firewall rules). Will attach sanitized VPC diagram.
Jonas Park: Also include a short blurb about our SOC2 scope and any compensating controls for multi-tenant hosted mode. They asked specifically about tenant isolation.
Theo Ramirez: For tenant isolation: explain logical isolation (namespaces, strict resource tagging), RBAC, and per-tenant telemetry. I'll draft 2-3 sentences and link the tenant isolation design doc.
Priya Kapoor: Procurement wants signed attestations where possible. Do we have a one-page attestation template for SOC2/ISO they accept?
Theo Ramirez: We have a standard attestation PDF. Anika, can you confirm latest pentest summary is ok to share?
Anika Bose: Yes, pentest summary redacted v2025 ok. Uploading to shared folder now.
deploy-bot: Artifact uploaded: pentest_summary_2025_redacted.pdf (shared with sales, security).
Jonas Park: Great. Timeline: draft SIG answers Thu EOD, internal review Fri morning, final bundle to customer Fri afternoon. Assigning owners: Theo=security narratives, Anika=network + diagrams, Priya=coordination + final ZIP.
Anika Bose: Quick question on evidence: for rotation evidence do we need the exact command history or a brief policy + sample command?
Theo Ramirez: Brief policy + sample command is standard. For AWS KMS we usually give example:
```bash
aws kms enable-key-rotation --key-id alias/redwood-prod-cmk
```
Add note that for Private/on-prem customers we support external HSMs via PKCS11 connector.
Priya Kapoor: I've created folder: https://redwoodapps.internal/sales/aurelia/sig-evidence. Please upload artifacts there and name files with short descriptors (soc2.pdf, pentest.pdf, kms-policy.txt).
Jonas Park: Also scope the POC: Aurelia asked for a one-week on-prem POC with sample PHI-like dataset. Security: what are the gating conditions?
Theo Ramirez: Gating: isolated network, ephemeral creds, signed Data Processing Agreement in place, and a brief threat model signoff. We'll need legal to expedite the DPA.
Priya Kapoor: I'll loop legal. Jonas, I'll confirm pricing for Dedicated + Private add-on and include POC uplift in the ZIP.
Anika Bose: Uploaded VPC diagram and sanitized IAM JSON. Pls confirm if IAM needs further redaction.
deploy-bot: Artifact uploaded: vpc_diagram_aurelia.png, iam_policy_sanitized.json.
Theo Ramirez: Draft narratives posted to Confluence: https://docs.redwood.internal/security/aurelia-sig (visibility: sales+security). I left TODO flags where I need product input (multi-tenant metrics retention).
Priya Kapoor: I'll collect product answers. Can everyone tag me when uploads are done? I'll assemble the ZIP and a manifest.
Jonas Park: Thanks all. If we can hit Fri morning review, we stand a good chance of getting them over the board Monday. Ping here with blockers. :rocket:
